Obtained from either combining [[reformate gas|Reformate Gas]] with [[chlorine gas|Chlorine Gas]] or by [[breeding|Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber]] [[chlorinated petroleum wax|Chlorinated Petroleum Wax]]. High-Performance Solvent is primarily used for advanced [[bedrock ore processing|Bedrock Ore Processing]] or the production of [[fullerene solution|Fullerene Solution]] for [[crystalline fullerite|Crystalline Fullerite]].
